headline.description: One-line email subject, plain text, no markdown, under 90 characters.

summary.description: 1-2 short paragraphs in plain English about what changed, under 900 characters.

highlights.description: 1-6 short bullet points, most client-relevant first, each under 160 characters.

risk_notes.description: Anything a non-technical client should be cautious about, under 300 characters, or null.
